name: printing-system
description: Distributed printing system monorepo: print-common, print-server, print-agent, print-client.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=print-common && npm run build --workspace=print-server && npm run build --workspace=print-agent && npm run build --workspace=print-client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=print-common && npm run typecheck --workspace=print-server && npm run typecheck --workspace=print-agent
scripts.clean: npm run clean --workspace=print-common && npm run clean --workspace=print-server && npm run clean --workspace=print-agent
